content: Tamâta ino pa Maro Kindeni tu ma ikea ŋana i kâ
Yova Kindeni, pwai naŋa piti lâ kinzi tamâta sakamao mbaunzi ilo. Kinzi tamâta ŋinde ilonzi tu sipunzi tamâta. Mine kala ano pano tu pwea ŋanana.
Ikura zo rârâni kinzi kalonzi ŋgere ŋana mâsi sakamao nâ. Aku kinzi siveta wisi-nâna tava kazâŋa ipâŋga ŋgininzi ikura zo zo.
Kinzi nenzi ŋgua nde mata-mata, itogo mwâta niŋo ruru ndo mwasina. Mao nâ, kinzi kawanzi ŋgua uru iyaulanzi tamâta, itogo mwâta saka ikanzi tamâta kala simâte mine.

Mine nde Yova Kindeni, pwatona naŋa, ŋana kinzi tamâta sakamao ŋinde nenzi walo ma ikura tu ipole naŋa tia. Kinzi ilonzi tu sipunzi tamâta, aku sipa ŋgua lâ tu ma sizavaru naŋa tona. Mine kala ano pano tu pwea ŋanana.
Kinzi taŋa-kaika tamwatanzi ŋinde nde sipavea ku sio nimbu ŋana sikai naŋa kaika kâ. Kinzi sikalolo kaimbo ku siveta nimbu sio lâ nzâla tu ma sikai naŋa, itogo uru sikai simbi mine.
Mine nde naŋa asarâwa pa Yova Kindeni mine tu, “Naneŋgu Maro Kindeni kala nokoni.” Yova Kindeni, kutambira taŋa pa naneŋgu noŋa, aku kumâ kuvilana!
O Koipu Ŋalae Yova Kindeni, noko kumo naneŋgu Yautâŋa Tamwata kaika. Muŋga, lâ zo ŋinde maka kamo paraŋa ilo, ande noko pwatona naŋa sondo nâ, kutogo naneŋgu maramuŋa mwasina.
Mine nde Yova Kindeni, noko ma kusâu panzi tamâta sakamao tu ma siveta vetâŋa ndia ilonzi tu siveta, mine ndimo. Kinzi sipa ŋgua ŋana siveta vetâŋa sakamao kâ. Naŋa ano pano tu kupono nzalanzi.
Noko ma kusâu panzi naneŋgu kazâŋa tamâta tu sizavaru naŋa ndimo. Vetâŋa ndia kinzi siporo tu ma siveta pa naŋa, ande naŋa iloŋgu tu noko ma kulele vetâŋa ŋinde itaulo pa warakanzi nâ.
Naŋa iloŋgu tu noko ma kuzavarunzi. Mao nâ, kusupwa yââ imbe ndue kulunzi! Kutambiranzi sindue silâ mbââ ŋalae ilo ku kusae nzâla, ŋana ma sikura tu siyâti simâ kilo tia.

Kinzi tamâta mine uru sisowe ŋgua laŋeŋa nâ lâ tamâta pinde tininzi. Noko ma kusâu panzi tamâta ŋinde tu ma simo ara, mine ndimo. Naŋa iloŋgu tu vetâŋa sakamao ma ipâŋga walele nâ panzi tamâta ŋinde uru ilonzi tu sipunzi tamâta, ku ma izavarunzi ndo lâ.
Yova Kindeni, naŋa asama tu noko uru kuvilanzi sugorai tamwatanzi. Aŋga tamâta ea nenzi kaika ŋalae koŋa tia kala sikura tu sipavila warakanzi tia, ande noko uru kuveta vetâŋa sondo ndo panzi.
Mao nâ, kinzi tamâta arara ma sipaneano sisuka noko ŋa kâki. Kinzi ŋinde ma simo kuku noko.
